rules.statement: A threat by a donee to cause bodily injury to the donor constitutes an act of ingratitude and is, therefore, a valid ground for the institution of action by the donor to have the deed of gift set aside.
rules.supporting_quote: "A threat by a donee to causa bodily injury to the donor constitutes an act of ingratitude and is, therefore, a valid ground for the institution of aft action by the donor to have the deed of gift set aside."
